fields.name: Hindi
fields.description:
परिचय

हिन्दी विभाग चैतन्य विज्ञान एवं कला महाविद्यालय, पामगढ़ का एक अभिन्न अंग रहा है। महाविद्यालय के स्थापना के साथ ही हिन्दी विभाग की स्थापना भी वर्ष 2001 में हुई। कालांतर में स्नातकोत्तर कक्षाएं सत्र 2012-13 में प्रारंभ की गई। विद्यार्थियों के शैक्षणिक, सामाजिक, नैतिक व सांस्कृतिक आवश्यकताओं एवं कौशल विकास हेतु हिन्दी विभाग सदैव प्रतिबद्ध रहा है। विद्यार्थियों के सर्वांगीण विकास के लिए विभाग में पुस्तकों की पर्याप्त सुविधा उपलब्ध है इसके अतिरिक्त संदर्भ-ग्रंथ तथा पत्र-पत्रिकाएं भी उपलब्ध हैं। अंचल में हिन्दी भाषा के प्रचार-प्रसार एवं आंचलिक साहित्य के संरक्षण एवं संवर्धन हेतु निरंतर प्रयासरत् है।

अधोसंरचना

  • विभागीय पुस्तकालय में विभिन्न पुस्तकें उपलब्ध।

  • एन लिस्ट (N-List) - INFLIBNET

  • ई-जर्नल्स और ई-पुस्तकें की सदस्यता उपलब्ध।

  • विभिन्न पत्र- पत्रिकाओं की नियमित उपलब्धता।

  • विभाग में कंप्यूटर की उपलब्धता।

  • विभाग में वाईफाई व इंटरनेट की सुविधा।

  • प्रोजेक्टर के माध्यम से कक्षा-शिक्षण ।

  • स्मार्ट क्लास रूम की सुविधा उपलब्ध।

fields.name: English
fields.description:
BRIEF HISTORY

The Department of English was established in the year 2002. The postgraduate course in English was started in 2014. The first batch came out in 2016. The Department has included contemporary needs of the society in its syllabus including various cross cutting issues. The Department continues to maintain its strength in traditional areas like Renaissance studies, Romantic, Victorian and Modern Literature. Since its inception the Department has served the society through its academic contribution. The research activities are being actively pursued. Our students are exposed to experiential learning pedagogies to enhance their learning to the various aspects of English Literature. The students are being educated with various digital contents of English Literature.

INFRASTRUCTURE
  • Books in the library
  • Access to N-LIST - INFLIBNET
  • Subscribed e-Journals and e-Books
  • Computers in the department
  • Internet facility in the department
  • Audio Visual Projection facilities / Smart class
CAREER SCOPE

The scope of M.A. English Literature for post-graduates includes content writer, teacher, translator, editor, copywriter, journalism in print and visual media.

FUTURE GOALS
  • To provide quality education so that students can analyze a broad range of literatures written in English (including representative authors and major literary periods), recognizing their temporal, social, political, and artistic contexts.
  • To provide enough exposure to the student so that they can use effectively a range of writing, reading, and research strategies applicable to multiple disciplines.
  • To develop skills where students can write analytically and creatively, that is to express ideas clearly and incisively in their writing in ways required both inside and outside of the academy.
  • To develop an advanced infrastructure for capacity building and skill development of the students viz. language lab, other foreign languages.

fields.name: Sociology
fields.description:
About Department

Our department was established in 2001 as an integral part of the college. Initially, the subject was offered only at the undergraduate level. Keeping in mind the enrollment of students and the importance of the subject, the college offered the subject at the P.G level in 2013-14. Since then, our department has been making progress at both U.G and P.G levels continuously.

Mission
  • To provide quality teaching, learning, research, and consultancy in humanities and social sciences by creating, preserving, transmitting, and utilizing knowledge.
  • The mission of the Department of Sociology is to promote scientific understandings of social life through teaching, scholarship, and service.
  • By providing rigorous training in disciplinary methods and theories, coupled with a diversity of substantive concentrations and educational experiences, we develop robust sociological imaginations and critical thinking in our students.
  • Through a variety of service activities at the local, regional, and national levels, we model for our students and others the importance of responsible community engagement.
Vision
  • We are dedicated to the production, critical examination, diffusion, and application of social knowledge in its many forms.
  • To build up confidence among the students.
  • To provide all the necessary facilities to the needy students.
  • To create social awareness among the students.
  • To guide students to create an interest in research pertaining to social issues in society.
Goals
  1. Key concepts: Students will be well-versed in the discipline's key concepts for analyzing the social world.
  2. Research Methods: Students will be proficient in qualitative and quantitative sociological research methods.
  3. Communication: Students will be proficient in discipline-based communication.
  4. The Main Aim of the Undergraduate Program is to train scientists with critical sociological knowledge, with qualifications that make them competitive in the domestic and international academic and working environment.
  5. Graduates of the Department of Sociology may be employed as teachers in Secondary Education, Local Government Organizations, the wider public and private sectors, among others.

Our department aims to develop thinkers, leaders, and innovators whose subsequent efforts will benefit the human social world and life on the planet. Our research ranges from broad, global sweeps of social change to micro-level social interaction, using an array of theories and methods. We generate new knowledge through our scholarship.

fields.name: Geography
fields.description:
About Department:

The Department of Geography was established in 2002, initially offering undergraduate programs. The postgraduate program in geography began in 2010, with the first batch graduating in 2012. Since then, the department has been actively involved in research, leading to the establishment of the Shaheed Nandkumar Patel Vishwavidyalaya Research Centre in 2022. Notable faculty members such as Naresh Bhaskar, Dr. Roshan Namdev, Mrs. B. Khan, and Dr. N. Guria have made significant contributions to teaching and research. The department engages in society-focused research, including flood risk assessment, drought-prone zone identification, and analysis of climate change impact. To provide students and research scholars with a productive learning environment, the department is equipped with modern facilities such as smart classrooms, computer labs, Wi-Fi, and a state-of-the-art GIS laboratory.

Career Goal:

Geography graduates are equipped for diverse roles such as GIS analysts, urban planners, environmental planners, and researchers.

Future Goal:
  • Develop awareness of the relationship between geography and culture.
  • Equip students with leadership skills and community engagement.
  • Promote spatial thinking and research capabilities.
  • Provide infrastructure including books, computers, and GIS labs.
Infrastructure:
  • Departmental and library books
  • Access to N-LIST - INFLIBNET Centre
  • Subscribed e-Journals and e-Books
  • Computer labs and wifi facilities
  • Geography lab equipment including maps, GPS, and weather instruments
  • Audio-visual projection facilities

fields.name: Political Science
fields.description:
Department of Botany

The Department of Botany, established in our college in 2017-18, had its first batch pass out in 2019. It stands as an important department in the college, offering Plant Pathology as an elective subject.

Infrastructure
Our College Botany lab is well-equipped for undergraduate and postgraduate students to perform various botany practicals. The laboratory is spacious, well-ventilated, and equipped with necessary instruments such as Dissecting microscopes, compound microscopes, colorimeter, centrifuge Machine, autoclave, respirometer, botanical charts and specimens. It also contains preserved plant specimens for studying botanical names and identifying particular plants in the field.
Herbal Garden

The botanical garden, under direct care, is adorned with various specimens essential for the study of Botany. It contains major plants like Calophyllum inophyllum, Kleinhovia hospita, Tectona grandis, Polyalthia longifolia, Cycas circinalis, and Azadirachta indica.

Career Prospects

M.Sc in Botany offers excellent career opportunities in both private and public sectors in India and abroad. Graduates can pursue careers as Ecologists, Project Managers, Environmental or Safety Specialists, Scientific Researchers, Quality Control Officers, Lab Technicians, and Medical Representatives.

Future Scope

Botany degree holders can work in various roles such as plant explorer, conservationist, ecologist, environmental consultant, horticulturist, plant biochemist, nursery manager, geneticist, taxonomist, plant pathologist, and farming.

fields.name: Zoology
fields.description:
Department of Zoology

Established in 2017-18, our department emphasizes a holistic approach to animal science, fostering a deep understanding of animal biology, behavior, and conservation. With a focus on fish biology as an elective subject, students delve into the diverse world of zoology.

Infrastructure

The department boasts well-equipped laboratories with a wide range of instruments, including microscopes, pH meters, incubators, and chromatographic columns.

Career Prospects

Graduates in Zoology find abundant opportunities in both public and private sectors, including roles as animal behaviorists, conservationists, zoo curators, wildlife educators, forensic experts, and veterinarians.

Future Scope

Zoologists can specialize in various fields such as arachnology, entomology, primatology, and ornithology, with opportunities in research, conservation organizations, national parks, and media channels like National Geographic and Animal Planet.

Established in 2006, the Computer Science Department offers a range of UG (BCA, B.Sc. CS), PG (M.Sc. CS), and Diploma (DCA, PGDCA) courses. It also conducts enrichment and value-added courses.

fields.name: Botany
fields.description:
About Department

The Department is one of those in few departments which were established soon after the inception of the Chaitanya Science & Arts College, Pamgarh in 2002. Over the period, the department has been nurtured under the able guidance of the eminent and educationalist/chemists. Late Dr. S.k. Vajapai then principal and eminent chemist extended his expertise in the modernization of infrastructure of the department. The present faculty members are actively engaged besides their teaching Programme in pursuing other scientific activities in frontier area of chemistry. To keep a pace with the advancement in frontier areas of chemistry our faculty members have been visiting laboratories and industries of renowned chemists of country and states. In addition, the department has been successful in establishing chemistry instrumentation, equipped with a number of modern, sophisticated instruments. This has brought the department to a level where we can venture to pursue skills in frontier areas of chemistry.

Infrastructure

The department has well-ventilated classrooms and most of them are equipped with multimedia projectors. The department also has tutorial rooms, seminar hall and virtual classrooms. The department has well-equipped laboratories and each lab is equipped with the modern and latest equipment to provide good hands on experience to students in all areas of their curriculum and to facilitate research activities.

Facilities and Expertise Available in the Department
For the students:
  • Virtual classrooms, seminar hall
  • Well-furnished library with the facility of e-library
  • Smart boards in smart Class Rooms
  • 24x7 Internet facilities within department for all students.
Laboratory Expertise:
  • Estimation by gravimetric and volumetric analysis
  • Isolation of natural pigments
  • Synthetic Organic Chemistry
Instruments and facilities:
  • Conductivity Measurement instrument
  • Water analyzer
  • Photoelectric Colorimeter
  • pH meter
Student Support and Progression
  • Career Counseling
  • Mentor for each Course
  • Soft-skill development
  • Problems solution related to grievance redressal guidance
  • Awareness about anti ragging activities
Best practice for the development of Chemistry
  • Donating personal books to the SC/ST students
  • Providing counseling to the students
  • Academic counseling
  • Career counseling
  • Felicitation ceremony/Programme for the university and class toppers
Teaching-Learning and Evaluation
  • NET/SET Preparation
  • Seminars in each semester
  • Assignments in each semester
  • Semester Results : Before 15th January & 15th July
  • Internal Evaluation : Transparent
Career Scopes

A chemistry graduate can go for becoming pharmacologist, toxicologist, forensic scientist, chemistry teacher, geochemist among others. Chemistry plays an important and useful role towards the development and growth of number of industries. This includes industries like glass, cement, paper, textile, leather, dye etc. There is a huge application of chemistry in industries like paints, pigments, petroleum, sugar, plastics, and pharmaceuticals.

Future Goals
  • To provide a broad foundation in chemistry that stresses scientific reasoning and analytical problem solving with molecular perspectives.
  • To provide students with the skills required to succeed in graduate school, the chemical industry or professional schools.
  • To expose the students to a breadth of experimental techniques using modern instrumentation.

fields.name: Forestry
fields.description:
Department of Mathematics

Unlock the beauty of numbers and patterns with our Mathematics Department. The Mathematics Department at our institution is dedicated to fostering a deep understanding of mathematical concepts and their applications. Through rigorous coursework, innovative teaching methods, and personalized mentorship, we empower students to excel in problem-solving and critical thinking skills, preparing them for diverse career paths in academia, industry, and beyond.

Career Opportunities

A degree in mathematics opens doors to a wide range of career opportunities in various fields, including academia, finance, technology, data science, cryptography, engineering, and more. Graduates with strong mathematical skills are in high demand across industries for their analytical prowess and problem-solving abilities.

fields.name: Computer Science
fields.description:
The Department of Forestry and Biodiversity, established in 2021, operates within the Faculty of Science, with a mission to foster comprehensive growth in forestry by nurturing world-class professionals and addressing the multifaceted needs of India's forests and its diverse biodiversity. Our endeavors encompass teaching, research, consultancy, extension activities, and publication to serve the forestry sector and advance academic and research excellence.

Our department is dedicated to addressing contemporary forestry challenges, including global concerns such as climate change, biodiversity conservation, wetlands preservation, and sustainable resource management. We emphasize solution-oriented research to tackle emerging issues and actively engage in technology transfer to stakeholders, including farmers, state forest departments, and voluntary organizations.

Specializations offered in Silviculture & Agroforestry; Tree Breeding & Forest Genetic Resources; and Forest Products & Utilization enable students to delve deeper into their areas of interest, fostering expertise in diverse facets of forestry.

By adhering to our vision and mission, we strive to make meaningful contributions to forestry and biodiversity conservation, ensuring a sustainable future for generations to come.
